ambientCG forest assets — CC0 1.0 Universal

Creator: Lennart Demes / ambientCG
Downloaded 2026-09-26 from the original source.

Leaf Set 014 (photogrammetry):
https://ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet014
https://ambientcg.com/get?file=LeafSet014_1K-JPG.zip
Included: Color, Opacity and NormalGL JPEG maps, unmodified.
Used as six leaf shapes on procedurally generated tree canopies.

Bark 007 (photogrammetry):
https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Bark007
https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Bark007_1K-JPG.zip
Included: Color JPEG map, unmodified.
Used with world-space mapping on procedural trunks and branches.
